description.narrative: This activity Procurement of Services for Economic Empowerment of the Poorest Programme is a component of Economic Empowerment of the Poorest reported by FCDO with a funding type of 104 - Procurement of Services and a budget of £12,865,103. It works in the following sector(s): Rural development, Social Protection, Urban development and management, Environmental policy and administrative management.
